text:
claire: Hit a weird onboarding flake: starter-go quickstart, first POST to /v1/chat returns 401 then 403 "billing: workspace_unprovisioned" despite org showing billing enabled. Token is from OAuth2 client credentials.

omar: that pattern usually means our provisioning couldn't map the caller to an org. client-credentials tokens often lack email.

claire: logs: ```auth: token ok (azp=cli-app)
provision: no_org_mapping -> workspace_unprovisioned
retries: attempt=2 err=403```

pat: short term: add header `x-redwood-org: org_0BXY` or set REDWOOD_ORG env in quickstart so sample requests include it. That yields a 200 + stream start.

omar: filed INF-5202 to add clear quickstart notes, SDK helper to auto-add header from env, and change error to `missing_org_mapping` for parity across SDKs.

claire: confirmed header fix works. devex-bot: quickstart-image v0.9.0 with REDWOOD_ORG support deployed to staging.
